newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's tax receipts outrun budgeted sum.
newsitem.headline: Spain's tax receipts outrun budgeted sum.

text.p: Spanish Tax Secretary Juan Costa said on Monday that tax receipts are around 80 billion pesetas higher than budgeted in the first few months this year.
"Now (tax) receipts are around 80 billion pesetas higher than the budget forecasts. We'll easily meet our target for fiscal receipts," Costa told state radio in an interview.
Costa added that more effective inspection in the first few months of this year enabled the detection of 53 percent more cases of fraud than in the same year-ago period.
